_about: The seven decisions the 1,000-user playbook needs (knowledge/full-time-1000-users-playbook.md, section 9). A channel in 'unlocks' stays held until its ruling is in force. A ruling is in force only when it is 'approved' here AND its 'evidence' is a heading in full-time's decision log (docs/12-roadmap.md), because the full-time repository is the source of truth for product doctrine. To record one: Krish rules; a full-time session adds the decision-log entry; an interactive session here sets status 'approved', the date, Krish's words and the heading as evidence, and adds a dated line to CHANGES.md. python3 growth.py --self-test checks the shape. Two entries from 27 October 2026 sit beside them: ORGANIC, Krish's exception that lets organic brand posts recruit pilot-beta testers before the December release, gated per take and needing D1, and RELEASE, the product's own release decision, which growth.py sync turns into marketing_release once it is approved here and its heading is in the decision log.

D1.title: Invite-led at scale: testers and every shared edition invite others; fan channels open
D1.recommendation: Approve once the rail gate opens. Until a match has 4 of 6 AI Pundits, posting to fans spends the first impression on a near-empty rail.
D1.words: Go now, per-take gate (Recommended). Reserve all, push three (Recommended).
D1.evidence: 2026-10-27 - Organic brand posts may recruit pilot testers before release, per-take gate

D2.title: Cover every Premier League match each weekend, not one a day
D2.recommendation: Approve after one full rehearsal weekend shows the pipeline fills the rail. Ten matches at today's pass rate is ten thin rails. Cost: at the roughly $6 per six-pundit run full-time's AGENTS.md measures, about $60 a ten-match weekend in model spend, before narration.

D3.title: Sign-up after the first finished show, and the morning recap for beta users
D3.recommendation: Approve. Without it there is no user to count and no reason to come back.

D4.title: Name Full Time under Krish's own name: LinkedIn, Show HN, Product Hunt, press
D4.recommendation: Approve with a written boundary that keeps the anonymised Mindmake proof story (full-time NOW.md, never_publish) apart from named B2C marketing.

D5.title: Paid creators (up to £600) and one paid test (up to £300)
D5.recommendation: Approve only after D7 and once the rail gate holds open for two weekends. Paid reach onto a thin rail buys churn.

D6.title: FPL "Beat the AI Pundits" league, framed as a game, never as forecast performance
D6.recommendation: Approve. It needs no product change and reaches millions of managers.

D7.title: Close the PostHog and Google Analytics consent item
D7.recommendation: Approve, with counsel's check as full-time docs/11-legal.md requires. It blocks open marketing and any paid test.

ORGANIC.title: Organic brand posts recruit pilot-beta testers before the December release, gated per take
ORGANIC.recommendation: Approved. A post is eligible once the exact AI Pundit show it links to is published and its facts check; four of six applies only to whole-match posts; D7 consent closes first. It opens no paid, founder or excluded channel.
ORGANIC.words: Go now, per-take gate (Recommended). Reserve all, push three (Recommended).
ORGANIC.evidence: 2026-10-27 - Organic brand posts may recruit pilot testers before release, per-take gate

RELEASE.title: The product release decision
RELEASE.recommendation: Decide in full-time when the December release bar is met. Until its heading is in docs/12-roadmap.md, public work outside ORGANIC stays held for RELEASE.
